title: LifeEvent
description: The trusted runtime observed Person's body die, or brought it back (ADR 0017, I3). Life status is its own axis: not world availability, not a session, not an episode result. It carries no cause, place or inventory: what killed Person is not something Person is told.

terminal.description: For a death: whether the configured semantics are permadeath. Decided by the runtime, never by cognition. Always false for a respawn.
